Sean —

Thanks for sending this over. High level: the term and uplift look fine to the business. Two items from our side before we can sign:

1) Data retention: our security team needs a clause that retains logs for 12 months for audit purposes (the SOW currently says 90 days).
2) SLA credits: legal moved to increase the uptime credit cap to 10% of monthly fees for repeated breaches — internal procurement will push on this.

I attached the MSA redline our counsel requested (MSA_2028_redline.docx). I believe most items are negotiable but Rahul flagged indemnity carve-outs and the credits as higher-priority.

Can your legal take a look and propose language? Hoping we can close the week of the 11th.

Thanks,

Novascale

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2028 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Uptick SOW + MSA tie-ins — Novascale redline (legal take)

Team —

Looping in Karthik from Legal Ops for intake. Quick read:
- Retention: 12 months for infra logs is reasonable; propose we add a scoped Exhibit that covers only auth/usage logs, not full customer data. That keeps PII off the table.
- SLA credits: 10% cap is high. Standard Redwood practice is 3–5% for repeated breaches with remediation obligations. Suggest counter 5% with an escape for force majeure and documented incident response steps.
- Indemnity carve-outs: Novascale inserted broad language for third-party telemetry claims. Need to tighten to actual breaches caused by Redwood negligence.

Action items:
1) Karthik — draft proposed language for the retention Exhibit and SLA credit cap (send as tracked changes in MSA_2028_redline.docx).
2) Monica — confirm whether the capacity lift requires an onboarding addendum (we may need a quick runbook and acceptance criteria).

I’ll prep a short summary for Sean to align with Novascale (2–3 bullets).

-Marissa
General Counsel (acting)
Redwood Inference

Marissa / team —

Attached is a redline with proposed compromises: MSA_2028_redline.docx (tracked). Summary of the changes I’m proposing:
- Retention: add Exhibit X (Operational Logs) limited to auth/usage logs, 12 months, with anonymization clause for query-level telemetry.
- SLA credits: counter to 5% monthly cap for repeated incidents, and add an incident remediation SLA (72 hours to provide mitigation plan, 30-day follow-up).
- Indemnity: narrow to proven Redwood-originated breaches; add mutual indemnity for IP claims and an aggregator cap tied to 12 months' fees.
- Minor housekeeping: add a deliverable acceptance criteria section for the capacity uplift runbook.

If the team signs off I’ll prepare a clean DocuSign packet with both the SOW and the narrowed MSA redline.

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the scoped language. The Novascale legal team reviewed your tracked changes and can accept the Exhibit X approach and the 5% SLA cap provided the remediation commitments are included (your 72/30-day language is acceptable). If legal confirms the 15-month aggregator compromise, we can finalize the packet and route to DocuSign. I’ve included the DocuSign preview link for reference: https://www.docusign.com/12345/novascale-uptick
